label: A cause of being has being, from agency in act
meaning: A cause of being is in act in some respect (agency in act, after q.75 a.2); whatever is in act in some respect is in act as to being (q.4 a.1 ad 3, sourced); so a cause of being is in act as to being. This reaches the esse rung of 'nothing gives what it does not have' with no transfer or preexistence principle, so neither the strong-emergence rival to q.4 a.2 nor the scope objections to the unrestricted principle bear on it. Each premise is needed in a checked interpretation (controls 10 and 11). No premise is established.
